title: Lower Charge
description: Lower body work with walking lunges and single-leg deadlift followed by an intense core

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Jog in place, heels kicking toward glutes

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + thoracic rotation + arm reaching to the sky

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot side to side

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Move forward in continuous lunges, big steps

exercises.name: Single-leg deadlift
exercises.instructions: Lean forward, one leg lifts behind, keep balance

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay at the bottom of the squat, small up-and-down pulses

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm and leg alternating

exercises.name: Shoulder tap plank
exercises.instructions: In a high plank, tap opposite shoulder alternating

exercises.name: Bicycle crunches
exercises.instructions: Elbow to opposite knee alternating, leg extended

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
